page.layout: One printed page, one text column at right of centre; running head above the column; no notes in the margins except faint show-through at the right edge (not transcribed).

main_text.p: tur: Hanc voco congeriem ex diversis Naturæ Phænomenis experimentisque certis & indubitatis; purâ narratione sine conjectura rationis, ob quam ita se habere videantur, propositis: Hæc Historia à docentibus in communia quædam capita digeretur: hanc tyrones non Legent in libris dumtaxat, aut ex pulpito audient; sed oculis ac manibus usurpabunt: tantisper suspecta sint, quæ ab his vel illis Physiologis arcana jactantur: Constat enim res obviâ facillimâque experientiâ tentandas, totam retro Vetustaten fefellisse: velut plumbum celerius labi per aëra.

page.notes: Show-through from the facing page is visible at the right edge and was left out. The running head is set in small capitals; the printed page number is 160. Line-end hyphens in "videan-tur", "pul-pito" and "experi-entiâ" are joined as printed; "experimentisque" is read as printed, with some doubt. "Vetustaten" and "fefellisse" are printed as shown; "tur:" at the head is a fragment carried over from the line above the page's first full line.
